method: Every figure is measured like-for-like from our price price snapshots of Bangladesh phone shops: official against official, import against import, one storage variant against the same variant, and a shop price comparison only across three or more distinct shops.

definitions.tracked: distinct handsets with at least one price ever recorded
definitions.snapshots: nights on which a price read succeeded and wrote rows
definitions.nights: calendar nights from `since` to `until` inclusive; `snapshots` below this means crawls that did not run or did not finish
definitions.in_stock: handsets a shop reports in stock today
definitions.listed: handsets any shop lists today, including delisted records still carrying stock

stories.headline: The Realme 14 5G official price is ==৳14,599 more== than it was a month ago
stories.caption:
Everyone tells you to wait, that phones only get cheaper. Here is what waiting a month did to the Realme 14 5G's official price.

৳24,500 on 10 September. ৳39,099 today. 43 phones we track cost more now than they did a month ago:

• Realme 14 5G: ৳24,500 to ৳39,099 (+60%, official price)
• Apple iPhone 17: ৳102,500 to ৳113,999 (+11%, unofficial price)
• Redmi Note 15 Pro Plus 5G: ৳45,999 to ৳56,499 (+23%, official price)
• Apple iPhone 16 Plus: ৳93,499 to ৳102,490 (+10%, unofficial price)

That is the cheapest listed price on that channel, read every day or two and plotted above. Full chart:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/realme-14-5g

Ever waited for a price to fall and watched it climb?

stories.headline: The same phone costs ==10.2% more== at GadgetAndGear than at the cheapest shop
stories.caption:
Same phone, same storage, same channel. What does each shop want for it on the same night? We ran that 161 times.

GadgetAndGear came out 10.2% above the cheapest shop on average. GaziElectronics came out 1.2%.

• GaziElectronics: +1.2% (38 comparisons)
• RioInternational: +1.4% (85 comparisons)
• SMSGadget: +3.5% (86 comparisons)
• Pickaboo: +8.0% (72 comparisons)
• AppleGadgets: +8.1% (66 comparisons)
• SumashTech: +9.2% (145 comparisons)
• Salextra: +9.9% (27 comparisons)
• GadgetAndGear: +10.2% (87 comparisons)

Shops bundle differently and stock different things, so a premium is not proof of anything by itself. But if you are about to spend six figures, the shop you walk into is worth knowing. Checked every day or two, every shop we track:
https://bhalophone.com

Which shop do you actually buy from?

stories.headline: Waiting 121 days on the Apple iPhone 17 Pro saved you ==৳40,509==
stories.caption:
Somebody paid ৳142,999 for a Apple iPhone 17 Pro back on 11 June. It is ৳102,490 today.

৳40,509, for waiting 121 days. The four phones we have watched fall hardest since the first night anyone here quoted a price:

• Apple iPhone 17 Pro: ৳142,999 to ৳102,490, −-28% in 121 days (unofficial price)
• Apple iPhone 16 Plus: ৳184,999 to ৳135,000, −-27% in 121 days (official price)
• Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra: ৳245,999 to ৳179,999, −-27% in 98 days (official price)
• Samsung Galaxy S25 Plus: ৳181,999 to ৳139,999, −-23% in 82 days (official price)

Every line is one channel against itself, so a sold-out listing never reads as a price cut. Night-by-night history:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/apple-iphone-17-pro

Anything you are holding out on? Name it and we will watch it.

stories.headline: Buying the Galaxy Z Fold 5 official costs ==৳162,000== more
stories.caption:
Official Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5, 12GB/256GB: ৳285,999.
The identical unofficial box: ৳123,999.

• Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5 12GB/256GB: official ৳285,999 vs unofficial ৳123,999 (৳162,000 apart)
• Apple iPhone 17 Pro 1TB: official ৳261,000 vs unofficial ৳102,490 (৳158,510 apart)
• Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB: official ৳264,499 vs unofficial ৳107,490 (৳157,009 apart)
• Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 6 12GB/256GB: official ৳197,999 vs unofficial ৳84,999 (৳113,000 apart)

Same storage on both sides, always. Quoting the cheapest official against the cheapest unofficial usually compares 512GB with 256GB and doubles the gap. Specs, shops and the full history:
